1.title: Pull out the house wires
1.say: Twist the orange caps off by hand. Pull the two white and two black wires out of the box.
placements: two white wall wires with bare copper ends → pulled out front of gray wall box, in the video: left side and right side of box opening
two black wall wires with bare copper ends → pulled out front of gray wall box, in the video: middle and right of box opening
orange twist caps → twisted off and set aside, in the video: off all four wires
watch_for: if only two wires stick out, a wire is still folded inside the box
if copper looks very short, pull more wire out so bare ends show
1.check_yourself: It should look like four bare wire ends sticking out of the gray box.
1.safety: Turn the heater breaker off before you touch any wire.

2.title: Confirm the power is off
2.say: Touch the yellow tester probes to the bare wire ends. Test each black and white pair so no power shows.
placements: tester red tip → touched to bare end of black and white wall wires one pair at a time, in the video: inside gray wall box
tester black tip → touched to other bare end of same pair, in the video: lower bare ends of box
watch_for: if the tester lights or beeps, the breaker is still on
if you only test one pair, another pair could still be live
2.check_yourself: It should look like tester stays dark on every wire pair.
2.safety: Keep your fingers on the probe handles never on bare copper.

3.title: Join the white wires together
3.say: Hold the two white wall wires side by side. Twist the yellow cap on to the right until tight. Push the joined wires to the back of the box.
placements: two white wall wires → twisted together under yellow twist cap tucked to back inside gray wall box, in the video: white wires on left and right pushed inside
two black wall wires → left sticking out front of box for next joins, in the video: middle and right of opening
watch_for: if copper sticks out below the cap, untwist and push deeper so only insulation shows
if the cap spins loose, the white wires are not twisted together
3.check_yourself: It should look like two black wires out and no white showing.
3.safety: Keep the breaker off so the white wires cannot shock you.

4.title: Join first black to thermostat
4.say: Hold the left black wall wire with one thermostat black wire. Twist the red cap on to the right until tight.
placements: left black wall wire → twisted together with one black wire from back of thermostat under red twist cap outside box, in the video: left side of gray box opening
thermostat with white knob → hanging below box by joined wires, in the video: below and left of opening
right black wall wire → left bare and sticking out for next join, in the video: top right of opening
watch_for: if the thermostat falls, the cap is loose so retwist until it holds weight
if copper shows below the red cap, the wires are not pushed fully in
4.check_yourself: It should look like one red cap holding the hanging thermostat.
4.safety: Keep the breaker off because one black wire stays live later.

5.title: Join second black to thermostat
5.say: Hold the last black wall wire with the last thermostat black wire. Twist the second red cap on to the right until tight.
placements: right black wall wire → twisted together with remaining black wire from back of thermostat under red twist cap outside box, in the video: top right of gray box opening
thermostat with white knob → hanging below box by two joined wires, in the video: below box opening
watch_for: if copper shows below either red cap, push wires deeper then retwist
if a cap feels loose, the two wires missed each other so redo it
5.check_yourself: It should look like two red caps holding the hanging thermostat.
5.safety: Keep the breaker off so neither black wire can shock you.

6.title: Screw thermostat flat to wall
6.say: Push the capped wires gently into the box. Hold the black base with white knob over the opening. Tighten the top and bottom screws with the screwdriver.
placements: all capped wire joins → pushed gently inside gray wall box behind thermostat base, in the video: inside rectangular opening
black thermostat base with white knob facing out → centered over gray wall box opening covering it, in the video: flat on white wall
top and bottom mounting screws → driven through base ears into box holes with screwdriver, in the video: top center and bottom center of black base
watch_for: if the base rocks, wires are bunched behind so repush them flat
if the base sits crooked, loosen screws level it then retighten
6.check_yourself: It should look like black base flat with white knob centered.

7.title: Press the cover on top
7.say: Line the white cover over the black base. Push straight in until it clicks.
placements: white cover with dial → pushed straight onto black base centered on wall, in the video: covering base on white wall
watch_for: if the cover gaps on one side, it is crooked so pull and press even
if the knob will not turn, the cover is pinching it so reseat it
7.check_yourself: It should look like white dial box centered on the wall.
